title: The Morphling Incubator
subtitle: A polyp grown to a strain
text: The Incubator grows a Morphling Polyp into a chosen strain. Seat the polyp at its centre, feed enzymes and catalysts into the four slots around it, and keep its tank in blood. It draws half a millilitre a tick while it works. At Degree 5 it is raised as a Working craft. Build its frame beside the Cardinal Focus of a Greater Working floor or larger, seat a Morphling Polyp in the Focus and light Swollen Leech and a Slimeball in the braziers. Feed the frame 200 mL and the floor takes it.
